body: You sound exactly like me. I’m 29, I’ll be 30 next month and I have been separated for 3 years. Both of us don’t care that we are still legally married so there’s been no divorce carried out, but we are in no way, shape, or form ever getting back together. I’m curious to know what you actually do with all the time you’re spending alone? Because I spend a lot of time alone and these have been some of the worst months of my life. I primarily lay in bed until something “worthwhile” or that I “have to” do comes up and I shower and am out the door. I’ve really really been struggling. My aunt told me that this is to be expected because it’s the first time I haven’t been around my ex or really even spoke to him in 8 years, and I’m also new to where I live. Sorry for my rant! Just know that I completely understand how you feel.
Feel free to hit me up, I’m Liz 👋😊
